name: Custom domains

requirements.text: An account owner can enter a normalized hostname for their account.
IP literals, localhost, configured default hosts, malformed hosts, and duplicate claims are rejected.
LinkPilot generates a unique token and requires exact DNS TXT proof at _linkpilot-verify.<domain>.
Only an active domain with current TXT proof, application routing, and valid HTTPS may be assigned or used canonically.
Custom-domain requests resolve only links assigned to that active host, and failed revalidation pauses delivery.
Daily revalidation checks DNS and a no-redirect HTTPS challenge; token rotation returns the domain to pending DNS.
Automated certificate issuance, registrar/provider APIs, wildcard hosts, and advanced apex guidance remain future infrastructure.
Verification probes update state with a token-and-prior-status compare-and-swap so token rotation cannot be overwritten.
Pending custom hosts may serve only the verification challenge; public link delivery requires an active-domain resolution.

externalPrerequisites: Valid TLS certificate for each activated hostname

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unknown, pending, failed, and active custom hosts cannot expose authenticated or unrelated public application routes.
Concurrent token rotation wins over every stale probe outcome.
Domain setup remains manual; LinkPilot does not claim certificate or registrar automation.

observedBehaviors: The custom-domain screen shows an empty state.
A primary action offers creation of a custom domain.

implementationEvidence.description: Hostname rejection, active/pending host routing, no-redirect verification, token rotation, and compare-and-swap protection on success, DNS failure, TLS failure, and exceptions pass focused coverage.
An unclaimed host returned 404 and a zero-domain quota account received an inline plan-limit error without losing dialog state.

Current Task 3 domain coverage passed inside the focused run, including normalization, unsafe/default-host rejection, owner scope, DNS/TLS state progression, compare-and-swap token safety, prevalidated HTTPS probing, assignment, challenge routing, and deletion.
implementationEvidence.reference: tests/Feature/Domains/CustomDomainTest.php; Task 3 focused run (363 passed, 1 skipped, 4166 assertions)

implementationEvidence.description: Managed Chromium captured desktop and mobile empty states in a disposable Pro workspace, then restored the seeded workspace and deleted the disposable workspace; no HTTP/page errors or horizontal overflow occurred.
